 Sonorama Ribera 
 Sonorama Ribera 2027 will unveil its line-up on 25 November in Madrid, with the first tier of passes sold out
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Lucas Moreno 
 18 Nov 2026, 18:30 
 A 3-minute read 
 Sonorama Ribera · courtesy of the organisers 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Sonorama Ribera will unveil its 2027 line-up on Wednesday 25 November at the El Sol venue in Madrid , at a party starting at 20:30. Tickets, priced at €10 with a drink included, have already sold out. 
 The festival will run from Wednesday 4 to Sunday 8 August 2027 in Aranda de Duero , although passes give access to the El Picón site from 4 to 7 August. 
 No passes are on sale right now : the first tier, the €85 Early Bird, is listed as sold out on the official ticketing site, and the festival has not said when the next one will go on sale or at what price. 
 Sonorama Ribera now has a date to reveal its 2027 line-up. The Aranda de Duero festival will present it on Wednesday 25 November with a party at the El Sol venue in Madrid , according to its official website. So far, the only name confirmed for next year’s edition is Siloé , which the festival announced at its August farewell, and the first batch of passes has already sold out.
 Festival guide 
 Sonorama Ribera 2027 
 4–8 Aug 2027 · Recinto El Picón, Aranda de Duero 
 Tickets 
 Próximamente 
 The line-up, on 25 November at El Sol
 The Sonorama Ribera website announces the ‘line-up launch’ for Wednesday 25 November at El Sol, on Calle de los Jardines in central Madrid. Doors open at 20:00 and the party starts at 20:30, with four showcases before the announcement: Tenda, Chica Sobresalto, La Azotea and Sienna .
 Tickets cost €10 with one drink included, allocated by the organisers, but they are already listed as sold out on the festival’s official ticketing site. According to Cadena SER and Diario de Burgos, the line-up will feature more than 100 artists; the festival has not said whether it will also publish it on its website and social media that same night.
 From 4 to 8 August 2027 in Aranda de Duero
 The official website places Sonorama Ribera 2027 from Wednesday 4 to Sunday 8 August . The pass terms and conditions, however, refer to site access on 4, 5, 6 and 7 August , which means Sunday falls outside the concert site; the festival has not yet given details of what will be on that final day. The ticketing site places the concerts at the Recinto El Picón , on Calle Valladolid, and the first session starts on Wednesday at 19:00.
 The dates, the venue and everything announced so far about this edition can be found on the Sonorama Ribera page . August 2027 already has more confirmed dates in our July to September festival calendar .
 The illustration used by the official website to present the 2027 edition. Image: Sonorama Ribera Sonorama 2027 passes: first tier sold out
 Sales began on 11 August, when the festival released 5,000 passes at €85 , as we reported when the first Sonorama Ribera 2027 sale was announced. Today, on the official ticketing site, both the Bono General Early Bird and the pass for people with disabilities, both priced at €85, are listed as sold out.
 No other tier is on sale, nor are VIP passes or day tickets, and the organisers have not announced when the next phase will open or how much it will cost. The website still shows links for passes, VIP passes, purchases with the Bono Cultural Joven and the camping supplement, pending the opening of sales.
 If you are going with minors, it is worth knowing that children aged 0 to 11 need a child ticket and must be accompanied by their father, mother or legal guardian; those aged 12 to 15 need a general ticket and the same accompaniment; and 16- and 17-year-olds can attend alone with a signed authorisation. The other festivals in the province are listed in festivals in Burgos , and this month’s listings in festivals in August .
 Sources: official Sonorama Ribera website (home page, tickets and conditions for minors) and its official ticketing site (2027 passes and launch party), consulted on 18 November 2026; Cadena SER and Diario de Burgos (17 November 2026) on the number of artists; previous ModoFestival coverage (11 August 2026) on the first sale and Siloé.
